title: The Rat on the Rug
lines: A rat ran on the red rug.
The cat did run at the rat.
The rat ran up the rod.
The cat did rip the rug!
Dad ran in. Dad is mad.
Bad cat! The rug has a rip.
Dad got a rag. Dad did rub the rug.
The rip is not big. Dad is not mad.

questions.ask: What did the cat do to the rug?
questions.listenFor: Ripped it. It is right in the story. If your child is stuck, point to the word rip and read that line again.
He got a rag and rubbed the rug, and the rip turned out to be small. Listen for the rag.

questions.ask: Do you think the cat meant to rip the rug? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason from the story, like the cat was chasing the rat and was not looking.
